hero.description: Join a team that connects healthcare providers with quality pharmaceutical products across Myanmar. At Alvor Healthcare, your work supports supply, quality, service, and commercial operations that make a real difference.

benefits.title: Why Join Alvor?
benefits.description: We invest in our people with meaningful growth opportunities, supportive culture, and comprehensive benefits.

items.title: Health & Wellness
items.description: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family.

items.title: Learning & Development
items.description: Continuous learning opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional development programs.

items.title: Global Exposure
items.description: Work with international manufacturer partners and gain cross-border operational experience.

items.title: Career Growth
items.description: Clear career progression paths, mentorship programs, and leadership development.

items.title: Inclusive Culture
items.description: Diverse and inclusive workplace where every voice is valued and respected.

items.title: Work-Life Balance
items.description: Flexible working arrangements, generous paid time off, and family leave policies.

departments.title: Find Your Role
departments.description: Explore opportunities across our teams. Each department plays a vital role in delivering quality healthcare products.

items.name: Supply Operations
items.description: Coordinate inventory, storage requirements, orders, and reliable product movement across the distribution network.

items.name: Quality & Compliance
items.description: Support supplier qualification, documentation, traceability, complaints, and recalls to maintain product quality.

items.name: Regulatory Support
items.description: Coordinate product and market information across applicable regulatory requirements for safe distribution.

items.name: Commercial
items.description: Build responsible relationships with healthcare providers and distribution partners across Myanmar.

items.name: Customer Operations
items.description: Provide clear product, order, documentation, and service support to healthcare customers.

items.name: Corporate Functions
items.description: Support our work through finance, people operations, technology, and legal expertise.

culture.title: A Workplace Built on Trust and Growth
culture.description: We believe great healthcare distribution starts with a great team. Our culture supports professional growth, mutual respect, and shared purpose.

values.title: Quality First
values.description: Every product we handle meets rigorous quality standards. We take pride in doing things right.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: We build trust through honest communication, ethical practices, and transparent operations.

values.title: People Centered
values.description: Our team's wellbeing and growth drive everything we do. Your success is our success.

values.title: Continuous Improvement
values.description: We encourage new ideas, learning from experience, and finding better ways to serve healthcare needs.

cta.title: Don't See a Role That Fits?
cta.description: We're always looking for talented individuals who share our passion for healthcare. Send us your resume and we'll keep you in mind for future opportunities.
